items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: I made several records with Eddie Cantor.

ctx.x: That would be one with Eddie Cantor. He doesn't have that. Do you remember that? Recording with Eddie Cantor.

"Oh Gee, Oh Georgie." "If You Do-What You Do."
